recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not copy retired Sequence wording into MolecularDefinition without a new MolecularDefinition-specific Clinical Genomics decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11240 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the DSTU2 FHIR-core Sequence resource. It requested coordinate-system-specific end-position wording so 0-based coordinates have exclusive ends while 1-based coordinates have inclusive ends, with the final resolution pointing to Sequence.referenceSeq.windowEnd short and definition text.
initial_application: Commit d830ddede2fa70d5f6ccca85e723caa4a2c7a7bf applied FHIR-11240 together with FHIR-11235, FHIR-11236, and FHIR-11239 by updating source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.sheet.txt and source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml. The historical release3 resource profile preserves the applied Sequence.referenceSeq.windowEnd definition.
additional_context: Sequence is now listed under removed resources in source/fhir.ini, molecularsequence is commented out, and moleculardefinition is the active Clinical Genomics resource. Later commits deleted MolecularSequence and removed remaining active references. Current MolecularDefinition uses a different coordinateInterval/coordinateSystem model, so the old Sequence.referenceSeq.windowEnd prose is not a current build source target.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical Sequence clarification was already applied, and no current authoritative source file requires a FHIR-11240 edit.
